sources.scope: Exactly six original analytic hypotheses and literal iid Exp(1) stopped recursion. Fixed y,xRef,z0 and deterministic event depth n; arbitrary fixed Borel finite-valued absolute horizon b may be unbounded across histories. U reads the actual next record. Strict live event a(Hn)<U<b(Hn) equals the positive relative-cap event. Borel absolute density, every-history fiber mass<=1, guarded actual clock/whole-history append, exact actual restricted joint/marginal laws and all joint ENNReal tests on every old-history event (including null ones) are derived internally. Stopped time0, raw negative flow and T+max(u-T,0) off-support append are auxiliary only. No normalization, integrability, finite-wait, no-atom, survival or coordinate/provider premise. Existing actual-input a.s. nonaccumulation78 and half-open coverage79 are retained and not reproved. Only one coordinate edge within S87-I5/G86-11 is targeted. Finite ordered iteration, final88 survival/hazard assembly, endpoint resolution when used, actual count/prescribed path identification, A7 summability/fullA7, physical-time residual restart/Markov, invariance/semigroup/L2/hypocoercivity, implementation/errors/unbounded costs/main/composition/full papers/Goal remain OPEN.

assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel structure, including rank zero.
Exactly six source analytic hypotheses: α>0, α≤β, V∈C², α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v, η>0 and βη≤1; α,β≥0.
y,xRef,z₀ and deterministic n are universally quantified; the exponential product, clipped thresholds, stopped recursion and observations are literal definitions.
b is any fixed Borel finite-valued history function, possibly globally unbounded. F and G are arbitrary jointly Borel extended nonnegative tests; A is any Borel old-history event.

Joint measurability, actual clock/append identities, fiber mass and all distribution/integration statements are conclusions. No independence, normalization, no-atom or finite-wait premise is supplied.
units.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 define Rec=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, Hist_n=Rec^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), H_next=H_(n+1), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Let readTime(live(T,z))=T and readTime(stopped)=0; a(h)=readTime(h_n), and U(w)=readTime(H_next(w)_(n+1)). Thus U reads the actual next record, rather than being defined as a shifted waiting time. Set W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Set ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z) exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. The relative append A_rel(h,s) preserves every old coordinate and appends live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and stopped when h_n=stopped. Define A_abs(h,u)=A_rel(h,u−a(h)) and L_abs(h,u)=(A_abs(h,u),u). The raw harmonic flow at negative real time, clipped cumulative increment and stopped time0 are auxiliary totalizations. H_n,H_next,a,U,A_abs,L_abs are Borel; for every abstract (h,u) and every 0≤j≤n, A_abs(h,u)_j=h_j. For any fixed Borel b:Hist_n→[0,∞), finite at every history but not required uniformly bounded, put d(h)=max(b(h)−a(h),0) and D_b(h,u)=1_{a(h)<u<b(h)}ρ(h_n,u−a(h)). Define B_rel={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))} and B={w:H_n(w)_n and H_next(w)_(n+1) are live, a(H_n(w))<U(w)<b(H_n(w))}. Let X(w)=(H_n(w),U(w)), Y(w)=(H_next(w),U(w)), and ν_b=D_b(μ_n⊗du), where du is real Lebesgue measure. D_b is jointly Borel and ∫_ℝD_b(h,u)du≤1 for EVERY abstract history h. B,X,Y are Borel and B_rel=B pointwise. For every w∈B, U(w)=a(H_n(w))+t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n) and H_next(w)=A_abs(X(w)). The exact restricted laws are X_*(P|B)=ν_b, Y_*(P|B)=(L_abs)_*ν_b and (H_next)_*(P|B)=(A_abs)_*ν_b, with ν_b(univ)≤1. For every jointly Borel G:Hist_n×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du is Borel and, for every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}G(X(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du is Borel and ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). No boundedness or integrability of F,G, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, finite wait, no-atom, probability or density provider is assumed. This includes n=0, rank zero, zero hazard, stopped records, live infinite waits, b(h)≤a(h), null A and unrealizable histories; missing mass is not normalized. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one absolute-coordinate ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), not a standalone printed theorem. Finite ordered iteration, terminal survival/full path/count assembly, full(A.7), physical-time restart/Markovness, invariance, hypocoercivity, implementation/errors/unbounded query costs/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN.

steps.title: Retain the literal model and actual next record
steps.text: Expand the sealed literal clock, reflection, harmonic flow, stopped recursion and complete histories. Reuse the complete-history extension and conditional-density producers with the same six source hypotheses. Define U by reading the next record itself, a by reading the old last record, and absolute append by subtracting a(h) before relative append. No clock identity is assumed.
steps.lean:
classical
  let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
  let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
        (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
     (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
  let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
    (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
      ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
  let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
  let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
    MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
      (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
        Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
      (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
  let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
    match r with
    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
    | Sum.inl a =>
      if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
        Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
  let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
      ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
    Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
  let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
  let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
  let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
      (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
    fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
  let waitObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
    fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
      | Sum.inl a => τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
  let timeObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun y xRef q => ((waitObs y xRef q).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0)
  let density : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ :=
    fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
      | Sum.inl a => ENNReal.ofReal (rate xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 a.2) *
          Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)))
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
  change
    ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ n : ℕ,
      let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
      let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → Rec
      let HistNext := Fin (n + 2) → Rec
      let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
      let lastNext : Fin (n + 2) := ⟨n + 1, Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1)⟩
      let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
      let Hnext : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext := history y xRef z₀ (n + 1)
      let readTime : Rec → ℝ := fun r => match r with
        | Sum.inl q => (q.1 : ℝ)
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
      let a : Hist → ℝ := fun h => readTime (h last)
      let U : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ := fun w => readTime (Hnext w lastNext)
      let appendRel : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p =>
        Fin.snoc p.1 (match p.1 last with
          | Sum.inl q => Sum.inl (q.1 + Real.toNNReal p.2,
              S xRef (Φ y xRef p.2 q.2))
          | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ())
      let appendAbs : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p => appendRel (p.1, p.2 - a p.1)
      let liftAbs : Hist × ℝ → HistNext × ℝ := fun p => (appendAbs p, p.2)
      Measurable H ∧ Measurable Hnext ∧ Measurable a ∧ Measurable U ∧
      Measurable appendAbs ∧ Measurable liftAbs ∧
      (∀ p : Hist × ℝ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), appendAbs p j.castSucc = p.1 j) ∧
      (∀ b : Hist → ℝ≥0, Measurable b →
        let d : Hist → ℝ≥0 := fun h => Real.toNNReal ((b h : ℝ) - a h)
        let μ : Measure Hist := Measure.map H P
        let D : Hist → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h u =>
          if a h < u ∧ u < (b h : ℝ) then density y xRef (h last, u - a h) else 0
        let Brel : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) ∧
          waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) <
            ((d (H w) : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)}
        let B : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (∃ q, H w last = Sum.inl q) ∧
          (∃ q, Hnext w lastNext = Sum.inl q) ∧
          a (H w) < U w ∧ U w < (b (H w) : ℝ)}
        let X : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist × ℝ := fun w => (H w, U w)
        let Y : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext × ℝ := fun w => (Hnext w, U w)
        let ν : Measure (Hist × ℝ) := (μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity
          (fun p => D p.1 p.2)
        Measurable (Function.uncurry D) ∧
        (∀ h : Hist, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, D h u) ≤ 1) ∧
        MeasurableSet B ∧ Measurable X ∧ Measurable Y ∧ Brel = B ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B, U w = a (H w) +
          timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n)) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B, Hnext w = appendAbs (X w)) ∧
        Measure.map X (P.restrict B) = ν ∧
        Measure.map Y (P.restrict B) = Measure.map liftAbs ν ∧
        Measure.map Hnext (P.restrict B) = Measure.map appendAbs ν ∧
        ν Set.univ ≤ 1 ∧
        (∀ G : Hist × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable G →
          Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∧
          (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
            (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, G (X w) ∂P) =
              ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∂μ)) ∧
        (∀ F : HistNext × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F →
          Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ u : ℝ, F (liftAbs (h, u)) * D h u) ∧
          (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
            (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, F (Y w) ∂P) =
              ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, F (liftAbs (h, u)) * D h u) ∂μ)))

  have h90 := ActualFiniteHistoryExtension.actual_finite_history_extension
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  have h89 := ActualConditionalNextWaitDensity.actual_conditional_next_wait_density
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  intro y xRef z₀ n
  let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
  let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → Rec
  let HistNext := Fin (n + 2) → Rec
  let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
  let lastNext : Fin (n + 2) := ⟨n + 1, Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1)⟩
  let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
  let Hnext : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext := history y xRef z₀ (n + 1)
  let readTime : Rec → ℝ := fun r => match r with
    | Sum.inl q => (q.1 : ℝ)
    | Sum.inr _ => 0
  let a : Hist → ℝ := fun h => readTime (h last)
  let U : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ := fun w => readTime (Hnext w lastNext)
  let appendRel : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p =>
    Fin.snoc p.1 (match p.1 last with
      | Sum.inl q => Sum.inl (q.1 + Real.toNNReal p.2,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef p.2 q.2))
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ())
  let appendAbs : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p => appendRel (p.1, p.2 - a p.1)
  let liftAbs : Hist × ℝ → HistNext × ℝ := fun p => (appendAbs p, p.2)
  change Measurable H ∧ Measurable Hnext ∧ Measurable a ∧ Measurable U ∧
    Measurable appendAbs ∧ Measurable liftAbs ∧
    (∀ p : Hist × ℝ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), appendAbs p j.castSucc = p.1 j) ∧ _

steps.title: Prove Borel observers and preserve every old coordinate
steps.text: The complete next history is Borel by the preceding producer; each old coordinate is its projection. readTime is a Borel sum-elimination, with constant0 on stopped. Composition gives Borel a and U. The Borel map (h,u)↦(h,u−a(h)), followed by the existing relative append, gives Borel absolute append; pairing with u gives its lift. The relative prefix identity preserves all old coordinates for every real u, including auxiliary off-support inputs.
steps.formula: H_n,H_{n+1},a,U,A_{\rm abs},L_{\rm abs}\ \text{are Borel};\quad A_{\rm abs}(h,u)_j=h_j\ (j\le n).
steps.lean:
have hnext : Measurable Hnext := (h90 y xRef z₀ n).1
  have hrel : Measurable appendRel := (h90 y xRef z₀ n).2.1
  have hprefix (p : Hist × ℝ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : appendRel p j.castSucc = p.1 j :=
    (h90 y xRef z₀ n).2.2.2.1 p j
  have hhistory : Measurable H := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    exact (measurable_pi_apply j.castSucc).comp hnext
  have hread : Measurable readTime := by
    change Measurable (Sum.elim (fun q : ℝ≥0 × (E × E) => (q.1 : ℝ))
      (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℝ)))
    exact (measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp measurable_fst).sumElim measurable_const
  have ha : Measurable a := hread.comp (measurable_pi_apply last)
  have hU : Measurable U := hread.comp ((measurable_pi_apply lastNext).comp hnext)
  have happend : Measurable appendAbs :=
    hrel.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk (measurable_snd.sub (ha.comp measurable_fst)))
  have hlift : Measurable liftAbs := happend.prodMk measurable_snd
  refine ⟨hhistory, hnext, ha, hU, happend, hlift,
    (fun p j => hprefix (p.1, p.2 - a p.1) j), ?_⟩

steps.title: Translate the strict density and its fiber mass
steps.text: For fixed Borel b, the positive part d=(b−a)₊ is Borel. The strict region a(h)<u<b(h) is Borel, so multiplying the shifted old density by its indicator gives jointly Borel D_b. Elementary real inequalities show a<a+s<b iff 0<s<d; the assertion remains true when b≤a, when both sides are false. Thus D_b(h,a+s)=D_rel(h,s). Lebesgue translation invariance in each fixed history fiber preserves its nonnegative integral, and the verified relative density bound gives ∫D_b≤1 for every history. This is a fiberwise change of variables, with no unproved product-shear certificate.

intro b hb
  let d : Hist → ℝ≥0 := fun h => Real.toNNReal ((b h : ℝ) - a h)
  let μ : Measure Hist := Measure.map H P
  let D : Hist → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h u =>
    if a h < u ∧ u < (b h : ℝ) then density y xRef (h last, u - a h) else 0
  let Brel : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
    (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) ∧
    waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) <
      ((d (H w) : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)}
  let B : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
    (∃ q, H w last = Sum.inl q) ∧
    (∃ q, Hnext w lastNext = Sum.inl q) ∧
    a (H w) < U w ∧ U w < (b (H w) : ℝ)}
  let X : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist × ℝ := fun w => (H w, U w)
  let Y : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext × ℝ := fun w => (Hnext w, U w)
  let ν : Measure (Hist × ℝ) := (μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity
    (fun p => D p.1 p.2)
  change Measurable (Function.uncurry D) ∧
    (∀ h : Hist, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, D h u) ≤ 1) ∧ _
  have hd : Measurable d := measurable_real_toNNReal.comp
    ((measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp hb).sub ha)
  have hrho : Measurable (density y xRef) := (h89 y xRef z₀ n).2.1
  have hD : Measurable (Function.uncurry D) := by
    have hguard : MeasurableSet {p : Hist × ℝ |
        a p.1 < p.2 ∧ p.2 < (b p.1 : ℝ)} :=
      (measurableSet_lt (ha.comp measurable_fst) measurable_snd).inter
        (measurableSet_lt measurable_snd
          (measurable_coe_nnreal_real.comp (hb.comp measurable_fst)))
    exact (hrho.comp (((measurable_pi_apply last).comp measurable_fst).prodMk
      (measurable_snd.sub (ha.comp measurable_fst)))).piecewise hguard measurable_const
  let Drel : Hist → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h s =>
    if 0 < s ∧ s < (d h : ℝ) then density y xRef (h last, s) else 0
  have h89d := (h89 y xRef z₀ n).2.2.2 d hd
  have hcutoff (h : Hist) (s : ℝ) :
      (a h < a h + s ∧ a h + s < (b h : ℝ)) ↔
        (0 < s ∧ s < (d h : ℝ)) := by
      change (a h < a h + s ∧ a h + s < (b h : ℝ)) ↔
        (0 < s ∧ s < (Real.toNNReal ((b h : ℝ) - a h) : ℝ))
      rw [Real.coe_toNNReal']
      constructor
      · intro hs
        refine ⟨by linarith [hs.1], ?_⟩
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith [hs.2]) (le_max_left _ _)
      · intro hs
        refine ⟨by linarith [hs.1], ?_⟩

        · linarith
        · linarith [hs.1]
  have hshift (h : Hist) (s : ℝ) : D h (a h + s) = Drel h s := by
    simp only [D, Drel, add_sub_cancel_left, hcutoff h s]
  have hrelative_fiber (h : Hist) : (∫⁻ s : ℝ, Drel h s) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      (∫⁻ s : ℝ, Drel h s) =
          ((volume : Measure ℝ).withDensity (Drel h)) Set.univ := by
        rw [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ, setLIntegral_univ]
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        have hbnd := h89d.2.2.2.1 h
        rw [h89d.2.1 h] at hbnd
        exact hbnd

    calc
      (∫⁻ u : ℝ, D h u) = ∫⁻ s : ℝ, D h (a h + s) :=

steps.title: Identify the actual clock and absolute append on exactly the strict event
steps.text: Split the actual old record into stopped and live. Stopped remains stopped and has zero wait, so neither strict event occurs. For a live record, an infinite threshold-crossing time produces stopped next record and violates the finite relative upper bound. A finite wait v produces exactly live(T+v,SΦ_v z). Reading that record gives U=T+v; the cutoff equivalence proves B_rel=B pointwise, including v=0. This establishes Borel B and the actual clock equality. Substitute U−a=t in the preceding guarded relative-history identity to obtain H_next=A_abs(X) throughout B.
steps.formula: B=B_{\rm rel},\quad w\in B\Longrightarrow U(w)=a(H_n(w))+t_n(w),\quad H_{n+1}(w)=A_{\rm abs}(H_n(w),U(w)).
steps.lean:
have h90d := (h90 y xRef z₀ n).2.2.2.2 d hd
  have hBrel : MeasurableSet Brel := h90d.1
  have hactualRel (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : w ∈ Brel) :
      Hnext w = appendRel (H w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n)) :=
    h90d.2.2.1 w hw
  have hguarded (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
      (w ∈ Brel ↔ w ∈ B) ∧
      (w ∈ Brel → U w = a (H w) +
        timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n)) := by
    cases hrec : record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n with
    | inr q =>
      have hold : H w last = Sum.inr q := hrec
      have hnew : Hnext w lastNext = Sum.inr () := by
        change next y xRef (ε w n) (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n) = _
        simp only [next, hrec]
      simp [Brel, B, waitObs, hrec, hold, hnew]
    | inl q =>
      have hold : H w last = Sum.inl q := hrec
      have htime : a (H w) = (q.1 : ℝ) := by simp only [a, readTime, hold]
      cases ht : τ y xRef q.2 (Real.toNNReal (w n)) using WithTop.recTopCoe with
      | top =>
        have hnew : Hnext w lastNext = Sum.inr () := by
          change next y xRef (ε w n) (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n) = _
          simp [next, hrec, ε, ht]
        simp [Brel, B, waitObs, hrec, ht, hnew]
        constructor
        · exact not_lt_of_ge le_top
        · intro hw
          exact ((not_lt_of_ge le_top) hw).elim
      | coe v =>
        have hnew : Hnext w lastNext =
            Sum.inl (q.1 + v, S xRef (Φ y xRef (v : ℝ) q.2)) := by
          change next y xRef (ε w n) (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n) = _
          simp only [next, hrec, ε, ht, WithTop.coe_ne_top, if_false,
            WithTop.untopD_coe]
        have hu : U w = (q.1 : ℝ) + (v : ℝ) := by
          simp only [U, readTime, hnew, NNReal.coe_add]
        have hz : (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < (v : WithTop ℝ≥0) ↔ 0 < v := by
          simpa only [WithTop.coe_zero] using
            (WithTop.coe_lt_coe : ((0 : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0) < (v : WithTop ℝ≥0) ↔ 0 < v)
        constructor
        · have hcore : (0 < v ∧ v < d (H w)) ↔
              ((q.1 : ℝ) < (q.1 : ℝ) + (v : ℝ) ∧
                (q.1 : ℝ) + (v : ℝ) < (b (H w) : ℝ)) := by
            simpa only [htime, NNReal.coe_pos, NNReal.coe_lt_coe] using
              (hcutoff (H w) (v : ℝ)).symm
          simp only [Brel, B, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, waitObs, hrec, ht, hz,
            WithTop.coe_lt_coe, hold, hnew, htime, hu]
          constructor
          · intro hv
            exact ⟨⟨q, rfl⟩, ⟨(q.1 + v, S xRef (Φ y xRef (v : ℝ) q.2)), rfl⟩,
              hcore.mp hv⟩
          · intro hw
            exact hcore.mpr hw.2.2
        · intro _
          simp only [hu, htime, timeObs, waitObs, hrec, ht, WithTop.untopD_coe]
  have hBeq : Brel = B := Set.ext (fun w => (hguarded w).1)
  have hB : MeasurableSet B := hBeq ▸ hBrel
  have hX : Measurable X := hhistory.prodMk hU
  have hY : Measurable Y := hnext.prodMk hU
  have hclock (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : w ∈ B) : U w = a (H w) +
      timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) :=
    (hguarded w).2 ((hguarded w).1.mpr hw)
  have hactual (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : w ∈ B) : Hnext w = appendAbs (X w) := by
    have htime : U w - a (H w) =
        timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) := by
      rw [hclock w hw, add_sub_cancel_left]
    change Hnext w = appendRel (H w, U w - a (H w))
    rw [htime]
    exact hactualRel w ((hguarded w).1.mpr hw)

steps.title: Transfer all old-history and absolute-time tests
steps.text: Let π drop the last record from an extended history. It is Borel, π(H_next)=H_n and π(A_rel(h,s))=h. For any jointly Borel G, use G_rel(h_next,s)=G(πh_next,a(πh_next)+s) in the existing complete-history law. The actual clock identity identifies its left integrand with G(H_n,U) on B. In each right fiber, Lebesgue translation converts G(h,a+s)D_rel(h,s) to G(h,u)D_b(h,u). Integrating over any Borel A gives the unnormalized identity, including null A. Borel parameter integration follows from joint nonnegative measurability, without boundedness or integrability assumptions.
steps.lean:
let oldPrefix : HistNext → Hist := fun h j => h j.castSucc
  have hprefixM : Measurable oldPrefix := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    exact measurable_pi_apply j.castSucc
  have hprefixRel (p : Hist × ℝ) : oldPrefix (appendRel p) = p.1 := by
    funext j
    exact hprefix p j
  have hprefixActual (w : ℕ → ℝ) : oldPrefix (Hnext w) = H w := rfl
  have htranslate (G : Hist × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hG : Measurable G) (h : Hist) :
      (∫⁻ s : ℝ, G (h, a h + s) * Drel h s) =
        ∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u := by
    calc
      (∫⁻ s : ℝ, G (h, a h + s) * Drel h s) =
          ∫⁻ s : ℝ, G (h, a h + s) * D h (a h + s) :=
        lintegral_congr (fun s => by rw [hshift h s])
      _ = ∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u :=
        (measurePreserving_add_left (volume : Measure ℝ) (a h)).lintegral_comp
          ((hG.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).mul hD.of_uncurry_left)
  have hGtests (G : Hist × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hG : Measurable G) :
      Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∧
      (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
        (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, G (X w) ∂P) =
          ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∂μ) := by
    let Grel : HistNext × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun q =>
      G (oldPrefix q.1, a (oldPrefix q.1) + q.2)
    have hp : Measurable (fun q : HistNext × ℝ => oldPrefix q.1) :=
      hprefixM.comp measurable_fst
    have hGrel : Measurable Grel := hG.comp (hp.prodMk ((ha.comp hp).add measurable_snd))
    have htest := h90d.2.2.2.2.2.2 Grel hGrel
    refine ⟨(hG.mul hD).lintegral_prod_right', ?_⟩
    intro A hA
    have htestA :
        (∫⁻ w in Brel ∩ H ⁻¹' A,
          Grel (Hnext w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n)) ∂P) =
          ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ s : ℝ, Grel (appendRel (h, s), s) * Drel h s) ∂μ :=
      htest.2 A hA
    rw [hBeq] at htestA
    calc
      (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, G (X w) ∂P) =
          ∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A,
            Grel (Hnext w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n)) ∂P := by
        apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (hB.inter (hA.preimage hhistory))
        intro w hw
        change G (H w, U w) =
          G (oldPrefix (Hnext w), a (oldPrefix (Hnext w)) +
            timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n))
        rw [hprefixActual, hclock w hw.1]
      _ = ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ s : ℝ, Grel (appendRel (h, s), s) * Drel h s) ∂μ := htestA
      _ = ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∂μ := by
        apply setLIntegral_congr_fun hA
        intro h _
        simpa only [Grel, hprefixRel] using htranslate G hG h

steps.title: Recover the weighted joint measure and its actual-history marginals
steps.text: Reuse only the probability-normalization component of the canonical exponential-product theorem to obtain probability P and its Borel pushforward μ_n. Apply the preceding test identity at A=univ. Equality against every Borel nonnegative test, Tonelli and the withDensity integral formula yield X_*(P|B)=D_b(μ_n⊗du). On B, Y=L_abs(X) and H_next=A_abs(X), so measurable pushforward composition gives both remaining laws. Their reference measure ν_b has total mass P(B)≤1. Missing mass is never renormalized.
steps.lean:
-- Reuse the canonical actual input probability; no new normalization premise.
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws.1
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hhistory.aemeasurable
  have hmapX : Measure.map X (P.restrict B) = ν := by
    apply Measure.ext_of_lintegral
    intro G hG
    have huniv := (hGtests G hG).2 Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ
    simp only [Set.preimage_univ, Set.inter_univ, setLIntegral_univ] at huniv
    calc
      (∫⁻ p, G p ∂Measure.map X (P.restrict B)) =
          ∫⁻ w in B, G (X w) ∂P := lintegral_map hG hX
      _ = ∫⁻ h, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∂μ := huniv
      _ = ∫⁻ p : Hist × ℝ, G p * D p.1 p.2 ∂μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
        (lintegral_prod _ (hG.mul hD).aemeasurable).symm
      _ = ∫⁻ p, G p ∂ν := by
        change _ = ∫⁻ p, G p ∂(μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity (Function.uncurry D)
        exact ((lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ hD hG).trans
          (lintegral_congr fun p => mul_comm _ _)).symm
  have hYactual (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : w ∈ B) : Y w = liftAbs (X w) :=
    Prod.ext (hactual w hw) rfl
  have hmapY : Measure.map Y (P.restrict B) = Measure.map liftAbs ν := by
    rw [← hmapX, Measure.map_map hlift hX]
    exact Measure.map_congr (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hB hYactual)
  have hmarginal : Measure.map Hnext (P.restrict B) = Measure.map appendAbs ν := by
    rw [← hmapX, Measure.map_map happend hX]
    exact Measure.map_congr (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hB hactual)
  have hmass : ν Set.univ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← hmapX, Measure.map_apply hX MeasurableSet.univ, Set.preimage_univ,
      Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ, Set.univ_inter]
    exact prob_le_one

steps.title: Obtain every next-history test and retain the remaining boundary
steps.text: For jointly Borel F, apply the old-history test identity to G=F∘L_abs. Its parameter integral is Borel. The pointwise Y=L_abs(X) identity replaces the integrand throughout B∩{H_n∈A}, giving the displayed identity for every Borel A. This proves one strict next absolute-time step; iteration over ordered times, terminal survival, full path/count identification and full A.7 still require separate proofs.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨hD, hfiber, hB, hX, hY, hBeq, hclock, hactual,
    hmapX, hmapY, hmarginal, hmass, hGtests, ?_⟩
  intro F hF
  have htest := hGtests (F ∘ liftAbs) (hF.comp hlift)
  refine ⟨htest.1, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  calc
    (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, F (Y w) ∂P) =
        ∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, (F ∘ liftAbs) (X w) ∂P := by
      apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (hB.inter (hA.preimage hhistory))
      intro w hw
      exact congrArg F (hYactual w hw.1)
    _ = ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, F (liftAbs (h, u)) * D h u) ∂μ := htest.2 A hA

units.lean_statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 define Rec=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, Hist_n=Rec^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), H_next=H_(n+1), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Let readTime(live(T,z))=T and readTime(stopped)=0; a(h)=readTime(h_n), and U(w)=readTime(H_next(w)_(n+1)). Thus U reads the actual next record, rather than being defined as a shifted waiting time. Set W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Set ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z) exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. The relative append A_rel(h,s) preserves every old coordinate and appends live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and stopped when h_n=stopped. Define A_abs(h,u)=A_rel(h,u−a(h)) and L_abs(h,u)=(A_abs(h,u),u). The raw harmonic flow at negative real time, clipped cumulative increment and stopped time0 are auxiliary totalizations. H_n,H_next,a,U,A_abs,L_abs are Borel; for every abstract (h,u) and every 0≤j≤n, A_abs(h,u)_j=h_j. For any fixed Borel b:Hist_n→[0,∞), finite at every history but not required uniformly bounded, put d(h)=max(b(h)−a(h),0) and D_b(h,u)=1_{a(h)<u<b(h)}ρ(h_n,u−a(h)). Define B_rel={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))} and B={w:H_n(w)_n and H_next(w)_(n+1) are live, a(H_n(w))<U(w)<b(H_n(w))}. Let X(w)=(H_n(w),U(w)), Y(w)=(H_next(w),U(w)), and ν_b=D_b(μ_n⊗du), where du is real Lebesgue measure. D_b is jointly Borel and ∫_ℝD_b(h,u)du≤1 for EVERY abstract history h. B,X,Y are Borel and B_rel=B pointwise. For every w∈B, U(w)=a(H_n(w))+t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n) and H_next(w)=A_abs(X(w)). The exact restricted laws are X_*(P|B)=ν_b, Y_*(P|B)=(L_abs)_*ν_b and (H_next)_*(P|B)=(A_abs)_*ν_b, with ν_b(univ)≤1. For every jointly Borel G:Hist_n×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du is Borel and, for every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}G(X(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du is Borel and ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). No boundedness or integrability of F,G, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, finite wait, no-atom, probability or density provider is assumed. This includes n=0, rank zero, zero hazard, stopped records, live infinite waits, b(h)≤a(h), null A and unrealizable histories; missing mass is not normalized. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one absolute-coordinate ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), not a standalone printed theorem. Finite ordered iteration, terminal survival/full path/count assembly, full(A.7), physical-time restart/Markovness, invariance, hypocoercivity, implementation/errors/unbounded query costs/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN.
